checklist page nav.#comment: User request of 2026-10-21: the PRIMARY and SECONDARY fire buttons also change the page of a long checklist. param dir = next: the page is finished (L:CHECKLIST_STEP reached ckl_end) and the button goes on to the next page at once instead of after the pause of the page; dir = prev: the button on the first row goes back to the previous page. ckl_cur is the page on the screen (set by every page macro, with ckl_first, ckl_end, ckl_has_prev and ckl_has_next); the event handlers in dispatch tablet UI call this macro in a thread. The links NEXT PAGE and PREV PAGE of the page do the same and set the same flags. Runtime PENDING.

commands.speak: <text:CHK.normstartupckl.02>Set Instrument mode switch to DAY or Night or NVG as required!
<text:CHK.normstartupckl.03>Set Battery Master Switch to Engage and then On!
<text:CHK.normstartupckl.04>On master list, verify the green Power up test OK is in view!
<text:CHK.normstartupckl.05>Set Test Fire 1 to , EXT . Verify FIRE BOTTLE 1 and 2 USED caution is shown on master list !

<text:CHK.normstartupckl.06>Set Test Fire 1 to, EXT, plus Warn. Verify: Engine 1 Fire, FIRE BOTTLE 1 and 2 TEST mesages are shown on master list! On warning unit, verify FIRE, EXT, BOT 1, BOT 2 lights are on!
<text:CHK.normstartupckl.07>Set Test Fire 2 to , EXT. Verify FIRE BOTTLE 1 and 2 USED caution is shown on master list !

<text:CHK.normstartupckl.08>Set Test Fire 2 to , EXT, plus Warn. Verify: Fire Engine 2, FIRE BOTTLE 1 and 2 TEST mesages are shown on master list! On warning unit, verify FIRE, EXT, BOT 1, BOT 2 lights are on!
<text:CHK.normstartupckl.09>Set Test switch to LAMP and hold. Check all indicating lights and EXIT emergency lights are on!
<text:CHK.normstartupckl.10>Set Test switch to OFF, make sure all lights return to normal!
<text:CHK.normstartupckl.11>On the VMS display: push NUM, softkey, then push Weights and adjust values. Validate and push PREV,!
<text:CHK.normstartupckl.12>Verify DC voltage is more than 23.5 Volts, check fuel quantity!

<text:CHK.normstartupckl.13>On Master list, Verify ENG,1 FAIL ENG,2 and AFT plus forward Fuel Pump, EPU connected (if connected), Pitot1 heater off pitot 2, power up test ok, messages are displayed! Verify no rotor brake message is in view!
<text:CHK.normstartupckl.14>On IESI wait for alignment, then, On MFD and IESI set baro as required!
<text:CHK.normstartupckl.15>On cyclic and collective, push and hold trim release! Move flight controls throughout full travel, check for free movement!

normstartupckl.speak: <text:CHK.normstartupckl.16>Set anticollision light as required. Note that must be on for engine starting!

commands.speak: <text:CHK.normengstartckl.02>Set fuel prime pumps 1 and 2 ON!
<text:CHK.normengstartckl.03>If fire guard is present, post him!
<text:CHK.normengstartckl.04>Make sure rotor area is clear!
<text:CHK.normengstartckl.05>FND master list: acknowledge messages!

then.speak: <text:CHK.normengstartckl.06>Set Engine 1 or 2 main switch to IDLE and start clock!
<text:CHK.normengstartckl.07>Set other Engine main switch to IDLE

commands.speak: <text:CHK.normengstartckl.08>Monitor N1, T O T, N2, Nr parameters increase!
<text:CHK.normengstartckl.09>Check engine oil, MGB oil and hydraulic pressures increase!

then.speak: <text:CHK.normengstartckl.10>On master list: check green STARTUP TST OK message is displayed!

else.speak: <text:CHK.normengstartckl.11>FND master list: check STARTUP TST message is displayed!

then.speak: <text:CHK.normengstartckl.12>On master list and VMS: At 60% of N1 verify STARTER ON message is extinguished!

<text:CHK.normengstartckl.15>Verify no system related caution indication is present!
